text: And Nadab{H5070} and Abihu,{H30} the sons{H1121} of Aaron,{H175} took{H3947} each{H376} of them his censer,{H4289} and put{H5414} fire{H784} therein,{H2004} and laid{H7760} incense{H7004} thereon, and offered{H7126} strange{H2114} fire{H784} before{H6440} Jehovah,{H3068} which he had not commanded{H6680} them.

And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Aaron,{H175} saying,{H559}

Drink{H8354} no wine{H3196} nor strong drink,{H8354} thou, nor thy sons{H1121} with thee, when ye go{H935} into the tent{H168} of meeting,{H4150} that ye die{H4191} not: it shall be a statute{H2708} for ever{H5769} throughout your generations:{H1755}
